children: outlined a November launch for Google Cloud's A5X Vera Rubin instances, while its shares traded at $322.70 at 11.15am EST Thursday, down 2.5%. The rollout adds more firepower to Google's AI infrastructure push. The commercial test is how quickly that computing capacity attracts paying customers.

According to Nvidia's announcement, A5X combines Rubin NVL72 systems, ConnectX-9 networking, Google's Virgo network and fourth-generation liquid cooling. Google plans to expand the infrastructure to as many as 960,000 Rubin GPUs across multiple sites. There is already an early user: Nvidia identified David Silver's Ineffable Intelligence as the first customer to access A5X for reinforcement learning.

Big capacity plans still need to earn their keep. Deployment speed, utilization and customer spending will determine whether the expansion strengthens Google Cloud's economics. The valuation snapshot shows shares trading 25.79% above the $256.53 GF Value estimate, suggesting investors already assign Alphabet a substantial premium. That raises the pressure to turn AI infrastructure spending into profitable growth.

title: Alphabet Stocks Slip 2.5% as Vera Rubin Cloud Scale Nears
